keysForContent.Heading: SUPPLEMENTARY LOAN AGREEMENT
keysForContent.content: THIS SUPPLEMENTARY LOAN AGREEMENT (“this Agreement”) made at place and date as mentioned in Schedule A hereto between the person(s) named in the Schedule A hereunder written (hereinafter referred to as the Borrower(s)(which expression shall unless the context otherwise requires, include his /her/their respective heirs, executors, administrators, nominees, attorneys, legal representatives, successor and assigns as the case may be) of the ONE PART;
keysForContent.content2: CreditAccess Grameen Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1956 (CIN: L51216KA1991PLC053425), having its Registered Office at New No. 49 (Old No 725), 46th Cross, 8th Block, Jayanagar (Next to Rajalakshmi Kalyana Mantap) Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070, (hereinafter referred to as the Company), which expression shall unless it be repugnant to the context thereof mean and include its successors and permitted assigns of the OTHER PART;
keysForContent.content4: Each of Borrower and Company shall individually be referred to as ‘Party’ and collectively as ‘Parties’.
keysForContent.content5: This Agreement is supplemental to the loan agreement executed by and between the Company and the Borrower(s)  dated as specified in Schedule A hereunder (“hereinafter referred to as the “Principal Loan Agreement”) (which expression shall mean and include such loan documents /letters/forms/declarations/undertaking etc.) signed or executed by the Parties whereby the Company has sanctioned and disbursed to the Borrower(s) a loan amount as specified in the Schedule A hereunder.
keysForContent.content6: AND WHEREAS the Borrower(s) by his/her/their application requested the Company for additional loan facility for an amount as provided in the Schedule A hereto (“Additional Loan Facility”) for the purpose as stated in the application.
keysForContent.content7: AND WHEREAS the Company, considered the request of the Borrower(s) for the Additional Loan Facility and has sanctioned the same vide  Sanction Letter dated as provided in the Schedule A hereto (“Sanction Letter”) offering an Additional Loan Facility for an amount as mentioned in the Schedule A hereto subject to the terms and conditions as set out in the said Sanction Letter and this Agreement including Schedule herein.
keysForContent.content8: NOW THERFORE THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH AS UNDER
keysForContent.content9a: 1.1.As varied by this Agreement, the various expressions defined in the Principal Loan  Agreement   shall have the same meaning as that given in the Principal  Loan Agreement
keysForContent.content9b: 1.2.The term “Schedule” means the Schedule A written after Article 5 of this Agreement.
keysForContent.content10a: 2.1.The parties hereto agree that effective from the date referred to Article 3 below, the Borrower(s) shall amortise the said Additional Facility as stipulated in the Schedule A, in addition to amortising the Principal Loan Facility as per the terms and conditions of the Principal Loan Agreement . The due date of payment of EMI under this Supplementary Loan, shall be the date as specified in the Schedule A to this Agreement. For the purpose of accounting convenience, the Company will maintain the two loan facilities of the Borrower(s) under two separate loan accounts.
keysForContent.content11a: 3.1.This Agreement shall be effective and become binding on the Borrower(s) from the date of execution of this Agreement and shall remain in force until all the outstanding under the Principal  Loan Agreement and the Supplemental  Loan Agreement are fully repaid by the Borrower(s) without any dues and arrears.
keysForContent.content12a: 4.1.Borrower(s) hereby confirm/s that security including negotiable instruments like Demand Promissory Note/Post Dated Cheques/NACH mandate, if any, offered under the Principal Loan shall stand extended for the purpose of securing the Additional Loan Facility availed under the Supplementary Loan. The Co-Borrower ( s )/Guarantor (if any) shall be liable to the Company under both the Agreements i.e.  Principal  Loan Agreement and Supplementary Loan Agreement. The Borrower and Co-Borrower( s )  and/or Guarantor ( if any)  confirm and consent that all the documents executed by them shall hold good and continue to be binding on them.
keysForContent.content13a: 5.1.Borrower (s) shall undertake to provide or execute any additional documents in respect of the loan facilities, at the request of the Company.
keysForContent.content13b: 5.2.Save as varied by these presents, all the terms and conditions contained in the Principal  Loan Agreement shall also hold good and continue to be valid and binding upon the Borrower, co-borrower ( s ) (if any) and guarantor/s (if any) for the Additional Loan Facility. Nor shall this Agreement in any way impair, diminish, or affect Company’s right under the any transactions documents executed in favour of the Company including this Agreement and Principal Loan Agreement.
keysForContent.content13c: 5.3.Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to be a satisfaction or release in whole or in part of the loan.
keysForContent.content13d: 5.4.The Borrower(s) acknowledge/s and agree/s that nothing herein shall constitute a waiver of any default or event of default and that the Company expressly reserves all rights and remedies that it now or in the future may have under any loan agreement, loan transaction documents and/or applicable law in connection with all defaults and events of default (including, without limitation, any event of default that has occurred and has not been identified as an event of default by the Company.
keysForContent.content13e: 5.5.The Borrower(s) further confirm(s) that he/she has fully understood his/her rights and responsibilities about loan amount, rate of interest, instalment amount and repayment schedule, as explained by the Company’s staff and they have also clarified all the details about the loan to his/her full satisfaction. The Borrower(s) acknowledge (s) that he/she shall be liable to pay the loan amount, interest and other charges as per the terms of the Agreement and in breach of the same the Company shall be entitled to initiate appropriate legal actions for recovery of dues, at its discretion.
keysForContent.content13f: 5.6.In the event of misutilization of loan or violation of any terms and conditions of the loan the Company has the right to recall the loan.
keysForContent.content13g: 5.7.The Borrower(s) declare(s) that he/she is of sound mind and health and that he/she is not suffering from any serious disease as on the date hereof.
keysForContent.content13h: 5.8.The Borrower(s) hereby authorize(s) the Company to mortgage, sell, assign, securitize or dispose of loans to any bank/financial institution/ third parties without any further reference or consent of the Borrower(s).
keysForContent.content13i: 5.9.The Borrower(s) have voluntarily and out of his/her free will opted to enrol himself/herself/ or spouse to Group Insurance Scheme administered by the Company as Master Policy Holder (MPH). Borrower (s) declare(s) that they opted for the insurance only after fully understanding the terms & conditions of the said Group Insurance Scheme. In the event of any eventuality or contingency, the Borrower (s) hereby provide(s) his/her consent to allow the insurance company to initiate split payment of the claim amount to the extent of the outstanding loans, in the name or favour of CAGL and the remaining proceeds of the claims due to or in favour of the nominee.
keysForContent.content13j: 5.10.The Borrower(s) voluntarily provides consent to the Company to disclose his/her personal and credit related data/information to (a) any group entity, employees, agents, representatives etc. of the Company ; (b) third parties engaged by the Company or any of its group entities; (c ) any rating agency, insurer or insurance broker of, or direct or indirect provider of credit protection to the Company or its group entity; (d) any service provider or professional adviser of the Company or its group entity with the right to further share it with their sub-contractors in any jurisdiction; (e) any credit bureau, Credit Information Companies, corporates, banks, financial institutions etc. (f) any authority or other authority or other entity as required by law ; (g) any other person to (or through) whom the Company assigns or transfers or novates (or may potentially assign or transfer or novate) all or any of its rights and obligations under the loan documents; (h) RBI or any Government or any other regulatory Authorities/Bodies/Departments; and/or (i) any judicial/ quasi-judicial authorities, statutory authority/tribunal etc. The above entity/persons shall use and process the information and data disclosed by the Company in the manner as deemed fit and in accordance with law. The Company shall have the right to disclose/submit the ‘financial information’ as defined under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (or any amendment thereto) and the Rules framed thereunder, in relation to the loan transaction, to Information Utilities (“IU”) and the Borrower should promptly authenticate such ‘financial information’; submitted by the Company, as and when requested by the concerned IU.
keysForContent.content13k: 5.11.The Borrower(s) hereby submit voluntarily and out of his/her free will share a copy of Aadhaar / e-Aadhaar/Aadhaar Number as issued by UIDAI (Aadhaar), to the Company for the purpose of establishing his/her identity. The Company has informed him/her that his/her Aadhaar submitted herewith shall not be used for any purpose other than mentioned above, or as per permitted under law and regulations.
keysForContent.content13l: 5.12.The Borrower(s) hereby permit his/her photograph, name, stories to be published in company  websites, annual report and other media as deemed appropriate by the Company for the purposes of marketing and training brochures, case studies, third party or consultant's print publications and/or audio-visual programs or for any other internal or external purposes.
keysForContent.content13m: 5.13.In the event of conflict between the terms of this Agreement and the provisions of the Principal Loan Agreement, the provisions of this Agreement shall prevail in relation to the matters specifically set out herein.
keysForContent.content13n: 5.14.Grievance Redressal Mechanism: Channels available for the Borrower(s) to contact the Company for complaints/requests/queries:
keysForContent.content13nc: Write a letter to head office - address mentioned in loan pass books
keysForContent.content13nd: Any Borrower or any other person having any grievance against the Company’s staff or services can take up the same by calling its Toll-free Number 1800 123 153 153 or write an email to yourvoice@cagrameen.in or address a mail to:
keysForContent.content13nf: CreditAccess Grameen Limited, #49, 46th Cross, 8th Block,Jayanagar, Bangalore - 560070.
keysForContent.content13o: 5.15.The Borrower(s) acknowledge that they have received and perused the Sanction Letter, Loan Repayment Schedule, and the Key Fact Sheet relating to the pricing and other material terms of the loan issued by the Company. The Borrower(s)  confirm that the contents of the Key Fact Sheet have been duly explained to them, and they have understood the same. The Borrower(s) hereby expressly accept and agree to be bound by the terms and conditions set out in the Sanction Letter, Loan Repayment Schedule, and the Key Fact Statement, which shall collectively and individually form an integral and inseparable part of this Loan Agreement
keysForContent.content13p: 5.16.The Borrower(s) acknowledge that the Company has adopted an Environmental and Social Management System Policy (“ESMS Policy”), which integrates environmental and social risk management into the Company’s business processes, policies, procedures, and strategies, and is intended to ensure compliance with applicable local and national environmental, health and safety laws, including International Finance Corporation (IFC) Performance Standards. The Borrower(s) undertake that the Loan and its proceeds shall be utilised strictly for the Purpose of the Loan as agreed under this Agreement and shall not be utilised for any activity or purpose that is prohibited under, or inconsistent with, the ESMS Policy. Any utilisation of the Loan in violation of this clause shall be deemed a breach of the terms of this Agreement
keysForContent.content13q: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed the …………day, ………... month and ………… year first above written.
